# Code of Conduct

## Our Commitment

buildingSMART International is committed to fostering an open, respectful, professional, and inclusive community.

All participants in this repository are expected to follow the buildingSMART International policies:

- [Behaviour Code of Conduct](https://www.buildingsmart.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/01/Behaviour-Code-of-Conduct-Policy-2023.pdf)
- [Commercial Code of Conduct](https://www.buildingsmart.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/17-09-08-buildingSMART-International-Competition-Law-Code-of-Conduct.pdf)

By participating in this community, you agree to uphold these policies and the guidelines outlined below.

## Expected Behaviour

We encourage all contributors to:

- **Be respectful and professional.** Treat others with courtesy, regardless of their background, experience, or opinions.
- **Assume good intentions.** Approach disagreements with an open mind and seek clarification before making assumptions.
- **Communicate constructively.** Provide clear, specific, and actionable feedback. Focus criticism on ideas and technical solutions, not individuals.
- **Be inclusive.** Welcome diverse perspectives and encourage participation from everyone.
- **Be open to feedback.** Accept constructive criticism, acknowledge mistakes, and work collaboratively towards solutions.
- **Keep discussions relevant.** Focus on the technical topics, standards, and objectives of the project.

Healthy debate and technical disagreements are encouraged, provided they remain respectful and constructive.

## Unacceptable Behaviour

The following behaviour is not tolerated:

- Harassment, bullying, discrimination, intimidation, or threats.
- Racist, sexist, homophobic, transphobic, ableist, or otherwise derogatory language or actions.
- Personal attacks, insults, aggressive language, or deliberately offensive remarks.
- Trolling, sustained disruption, or intentionally provocative behaviour.
- Inappropriate sexual attention, unwanted contact, or violations of personal boundaries.
- Publishing private or confidential information without permission.
- Repeated sarcasm, dismissive remarks, or vague criticism intended to undermine others.
- Any conduct that violates applicable laws or buildingSMART International policies.

## Competition Law and Commercial Conduct

As a vendor-neutral standards organisation, buildingSMART International requires participants to comply with applicable competition laws.

Repository discussions must not be used to coordinate commercial activities between competitors, including price fixing, bid coordination, market allocation, or the exchange of commercially sensitive information.

See: [buildingSMART International Commercial Code of Conduct](https://www.buildingsmart.org/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/17-09-08-buildingSMART-International-Competition-Law-Code-of-Conduct.pdf).

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to all interactions within this repository, including issues, pull requests, code reviews, discussions, and other contributions.

It applies to all participants, including contributors, maintainers, and representatives of buildingSMART International.

## Reporting Concerns

If you experience or witness unacceptable behaviour:

1. **Raise the concern directly**, if you feel comfortable and safe doing so. Explain which behaviour you consider unacceptable and request that it stops.
2. **Submit a formal complaint** if the behaviour continues, or if direct engagement is inappropriate.

[![File a Complaint](https://img.shields.io/badge/FILE%20A%20COMPLAINT-black.svg)](https://bsicommunications.typeform.com/complaint)

Reports will be handled in accordance with applicable buildingSMART International policies, with appropriate discretion and consideration for the privacy of those involved.

## Enforcement

Repository maintainers and buildingSMART International representatives may take appropriate action in response to violations of this Code of Conduct.

Depending on the nature and severity of the violation, actions may include:

- Requesting changes to unacceptable behaviour or contributions.
- Editing, hiding, or removing inappropriate content.
- Issuing warnings.
- Temporarily or permanently restricting participation in the repository or community.
- Escalating serious incidents to buildingSMART International management or GitHub support.

Enforcement decisions will be guided by the applicable buildingSMART International policies.

## Working Together

We recognise that mistakes and misunderstandings can happen, particularly in a diverse international community.

We encourage everyone to listen, reflect, acknowledge mistakes, and work together to maintain a respectful and constructive environment.

Thank you for helping make the buildingSMART community welcoming and productive for everyone.
